output.reason: The brief makes a convincing case that the departures are specific to Kestrel (8 of the 11 Kestrel associates left versus 1 of the 13 others) and that pay is not the driver, and it is honest that workload and Faulk's supervision can't yet be told apart; its next step is cheap and clear (£9k interviews over three weeks), though it doesn't say whether to act on Kestrel staffing in the meantime.
